messages:
kelly_ops: Hey team, curveball  woke up with a fever and need to be OOO tomorrow (12/29). Our team is in the year-end release blackout. I have ~8h vacation and 24h sick. Is sick time allowed during blackout or do I need to follow the exception process?

mike_manager: Health comes first. You don't need approval for sick time, just mark it in the PTO form. We only restrict discretionary vacation during blackout, not sick. Please DM me if you need coverage for any handoffs.

maria_peopleops: Confirming Mike is right. Sick/medical leave is not blocked by blackout policies. Use the regular absence workflow and note "sick" in the request. If you need extended leave (3+ days) we may ask for documentation per local law and policy.

kelly_ops: Thanks. Quick follow-up: if I end up using sick instead of vacation, does that affect my year-end carryover calculation? I was hoping to save vacation hours.

jordan_payroll: Carryover only applies to unused vacation at the year-end snapshot. Sick does not carry. If you convert vacation -> sick by using sick first, your vacation balance at Dec 31 will reflect that usage and reduce what can carry.

maria_peopleops: If there's a medical reason preventing you from using vacation (e.g., illness during blackout), we can consider a carryover exception for vacation hours lost due to medical blackout overlap. That requires manager justification + medical note and must be submitted via the Carryover Exception form before Jan 10. Exceptions are discretionary and reviewed case-by-case.

kelly_ops: Appreciate it. I may need to request the exception depending on recovery. One more: in CA do we have different sick rules? I'm in SF.

maria_peopleops: Yes CA/Local law can differ. For CA employees we follow state accrual and carry rules for sick. Short-term: CA sick accrues and has its own payout/usage rules, and doesn't count toward the 40h vacation carry cap. If in doubt DM me and Ill route to benefits.

peopleops_bot: Policy links: Handbook - Sick & Vacation: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/leave#sick-vacation (policy v3.6). Carryover Exception form: https://intranet.redwood/forms/carryover-exception.

kelly_ops: Filed sick PTO request PTO-DR-4421 and uploaded a photo of my telemedicine note. Will submit Carryover Exception only if needed. Thanks all.

mike_manager: Noted and feel better soon. Ill add coverage notes to the request.

maria_peopleops: Got the request. Well flag payroll and advise if we need additional docs. If you do request a carryover exception, submit by Jan 10 with manager justification. Get well! :heart:
